market_question: Will PSG win the 2025–26 Champions League?
reasoning: PSG are perennial contenders but have never won the UCL, and no single club has a true pre‑season probability anywhere near 58.5%. Even with Mbappé gone, their squad remains strong, but the Champions League winner is highly uncertain; top favorites typically cluster around 10–20%. The market price implies PSG is an overwhelming favorite, which contradicts all available evidence.
evidence_points: PSG have failed to win the UCL despite heavy investment over the past decade
The departure of Kylian Mbappé reduces their attacking firepower
Historical pre‑season betting odds for UCL winners rarely exceed 20% for the favourite, and PSG is not even the consensus favourite
sources_consulted: Public discourse on Champions League odds
